checks.details: Correct sequential fixture passed, injected fault failed, repaired fixture passed.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.

justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation concatenates 24 copies of in[7] with the original eight input bits; no subsequent RTL revisions.
justified_tb_changes: Initial independent arithmetic oracle interprets values 128 through 255 as stimulus minus 256; no subsequent testbench changes.
interface_cycle_contract: TopModule has input in[7:0] and output out[31:0], with combinational behavior and no clock, reset, or additional latency.
numeric_width_decisions: 24 replicated sign bits plus eight preserved input bits produce exactly 32 bits.
static_review: Single continuous driver; no storage, latches, or additional ports.
